text: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(oi.product_price) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.is_drink_item THEN oi.product_price ELSE 0 END) AS beverage_revenue FROM jaffle_shop.dev.customers c JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE LOWER(c.customer_name) = LOWER('Ryan byrd') GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name LIMIT 500
